description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Earthbending Student trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
